data.long_meaning: From the Old Prussian language, Janyte means 'Gracious Gift'. This name is often given to girls born into a Christian family as a symbol of God's blessings and love. The name Janyte carries the meaning “Gracious Gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Janyte usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
